<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { ActionSwapText } from "../../../motion/action-swap";
import { useMediaQuery, useReducedMotion } from "../../../lib/composables";
import { SPRING_PRESS } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { probability } from "./utils";
import type { PredictionMarketCardOutcome } from "./PredictionMarketCard.vue";
const props = defineProps<{
    positive: boolean;
    outcome: PredictionMarketCardOutcome;
  }>(),
  reduce = useReducedMotion(),
  hover = useMediaQuery("(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)"),
  hovered = ref(false),
  focused = ref(false);
const show = computed(() => (hover.value && hovered.value) || focused.value),
  cents = computed(() =>
    Math.round(probability(props.outcome.probability) * 100),
  );
</script>
<template>
  <motion.button
    type="button"
    :aria-label="`Trade ${outcome.label} at ${cents}%`"
    :while-press="reduce ? undefined : { scale: 0.96 }"
    :transition="SPRING_PRESS"
    :class="
      cn(
        'relative flex min-h-10 min-w-16 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-foreground shadow-[0_3px_0] transition-colors hover:bg-muted focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ring',
        positive
          ? 'shadow-emerald-500/20 border-emerald-500/25 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-500/15 dark:text-emerald-400'
          : 'shadow-rose-500/20 border-rose-500/25 bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-500/15 dark:text-rose-400',
      )
    "
    @pointerenter="$event.pointerType !== 'touch' && (hovered = true)"
    @pointerleave="hovered = false"
    @focus="
      focused = ($event.currentTarget as HTMLElement).matches(':focus-visible')
    "
    @blur="focused = false"
    ><ActionSwapText
      :value="show ? 'action' : String(cents)"
      animation="roll"
      >{{ show ? (positive ? "Yes" : "No") : `${cents}%` }}</ActionSwapText
    ></motion.button
  >
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component, VNodeChild } from "vue";
import ActionSwapButton from "./ActionSwapButton.vue";
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  items: { id: string; label: VNodeChild | Component; icon?: VNodeChild | Component; ariaLabel?: string }[];
  modelValue?: string; value?: string; defaultValue?: string; cycle?: boolean; disabled?: boolean;
  variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost"; size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon";
}>(), { cycle: undefined });
const emit = defineEmits(["update:modelValue", "update:value", "valueChange"]);
function changed(value: string, item: typeof props.items[number]) { emit("valueChange", value, item); }
</script>
<template><ActionSwapButton v-bind="props" animation="blur" @update:model-value="emit('update:modelValue', $event)" @update:value="emit('update:value', $event)" @value-change="changed">
  <template v-if="$slots.default" #default="slotProps"><slot v-bind="slotProps" /></template>
  <template v-if="$slots.icon" #icon="slotProps"><slot name="icon" v-bind="slotProps" /></template>
</ActionSwapButton></template>

<script setup lang="ts">

const props = defineProps<{ value: string | number }>();
defineSlots<{ default?: () => any }>();
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, type Component, type VNodeChild } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { SPRING_LAYOUT, SPRING_PRESS } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../../../lib/composables";
import RenderContent from "../../../lib/RenderContent";
import { useMotionState } from "../../state";
import ActionSwapIcon from "./ActionSwapIcon.vue";
import ActionSwapText from "./ActionSwapText.vue";
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  items: { id: string; label: VNodeChild | Component; icon?: VNodeChild | Component; ariaLabel?: string }[];
  modelValue?: string; value?: string; defaultValue?: string; animation?: "cascade" | "blur" | "roll";
  variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost"; size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon";
  iconOnly?: boolean; cycle?: boolean; disabled?: boolean;
}>(), { animation: "blur", variant: "secondary", size: "md", cycle: true, iconOnly: undefined });
const emit = defineEmits(["update:modelValue", "change", "update:value", "valueChange", "click"]);
const value = useMotionState(props, emit, "modelValue", props.defaultValue ?? props.items[0]?.id ?? "");
const index = computed(() => Math.max(0, props.items.findIndex(item => item.id === (props.value ?? value.value))));
const selected = computed(() => props.items[index.value] ?? props.items[0]);
const iconOnly = computed(() => props.iconOnly ?? props.size === "icon");
const hasIcons = computed(() => props.items.some(item => !!item.icon));
const reduced = useReducedMotion();
const color = computed(() => ({ primary: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90", secondary: "border border-border bg-card text-foreground hover:border-border", outline: "border border-border bg-transparent text-foreground hover:bg-muted/60", ghost: "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted/60 hover:text-foreground" })[props.variant]);
const geometry = computed(() => ({ sm: "h-8 gap-1.5 rounded-full px-3 text-xs", md: "h-10 gap-2 rounded-full px-4 text-sm", lg: "h-12 gap-2.5 rounded-full px-5 text-base", icon: "h-10 w-10 rounded-full" })[props.size]);
const accessibleName = computed(() => selected.value?.ariaLabel ?? (iconOnly.value && ["string", "number"].includes(typeof selected.value?.label) ? String(selected.value!.label) : undefined));
function advance(event: MouseEvent) {
  emit("click", event);
  if (event.defaultPrevented || props.disabled || !props.cycle || !props.items.length) return;
  const next = props.items[(index.value + 1) % props.items.length]!;
  value.value = next.id;
  emit("update:value", next.id);
  emit("valueChange", next.id, next);
}
</script>
<template>
  <motion.button v-if="selected" type="button" :disabled="disabled" layout :layout-dependency="selected.id" :aria-label="accessibleName"
    :while-press="reduced || disabled ? undefined : { scale: 0.97 }" :transition="{ ...SPRING_PRESS, layout: reduced ? { duration: 0 } : SPRING_LAYOUT }"
    :style="{ borderRadius: '9999px' }" :class="cn('inline-flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50', color, geometry, $attrs.class)" @click="advance">
    <motion.span v-if="hasIcons || $slots.icon" layout="position" :layout-dependency="selected.id" :transition="reduced ? { duration: 0 } : SPRING_LAYOUT" class="inline-flex shrink-0">
      <ActionSwapIcon :value="selected.id" :animation="animation" class="h-4 w-4"><slot name="icon" :item="selected"><RenderContent v-if="selected.icon" :node="selected.icon" class="size-4" /></slot></ActionSwapIcon>
    </motion.span>
    <motion.span v-if="!iconOnly" layout="position" :layout-dependency="selected.id" :transition="reduced ? { duration: 0 } : SPRING_LAYOUT" class="inline-flex min-w-0 max-w-full">
      <ActionSwapText :value="selected.id" :animation="animation"><slot :item="selected"><template v-if="typeof selected.label === 'string' || typeof selected.label === 'number'">{{ selected.label }}</template><RenderContent v-else :node="selected.label" /></slot></ActionSwapText>
    </motion.span>
  </motion.button>
</template>

import { computed } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { SPRING_PRESS } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../../../lib/composables";
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ href?: string; variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "outline"; size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon"; pressScale?: number }>(), { variant: "primary", size: "md", pressScale: 0.93 });
const reduced = useReducedMotion();
const color = computed(() => ({ primary: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90", secondary: "border border-border bg-card text-foreground hover:border-border", ghost: "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/60", outline: "border border-border bg-transparent text-foreground hover:bg-muted/60" })[props.variant]);
const geometry = computed(() => ({ sm: "h-8 px-3 text-xs gap-1.5 rounded-full", md: "h-10 px-5 text-sm gap-2 rounded-full", lg: "h-12 px-6 text-base gap-2 rounded-full", icon: "h-8 w-8 rounded-lg" })[props.size]);
</script>
<template>
  <motion.a :href="href" :while-press="reduced ? undefined : { scale: pressScale }" :while-hover="reduced ? undefined : { scale: 1.02 }"
    :transition="SPRING_PRESS" :class="cn('inline-flex items-center justify-center font-medium select-none transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2', color, geometry, $attrs.class)"><slot /></motion.a>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, watch } from "vue";
import { motion, useMotionValue, useSpring } from "motion-v";
import { SPRING_MOUSE } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { resolveElement, useMediaQuery, useReducedMotion } from "../../../lib/composables";
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ strength?: number }>(), { strength: 0.35 });
const element = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null), reduced = useReducedMotion();
const hover = useMediaQuery("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)");
const enabled = computed(() => hover.value && !reduced.value);
const x = useMotionValue(0), y = useMotionValue(0);
const springX = useSpring(x, SPRING_MOUSE), springY = useSpring(y, SPRING_MOUSE);
function reset() { x.set(0); y.set(0); }
function track(event: MouseEvent) {
  if (!enabled.value || !element.value) return;
  const bounds = element.value.getBoundingClientRect();
  x.set(props.strength * (event.clientX - bounds.left - bounds.width / 2));
  y.set(props.strength * (event.clientY - bounds.top - bounds.height / 2));
}
watch(enabled, active => { if (!active) { reset(); springX.jump(0); springY.jump(0); } });
onBeforeUnmount(() => { x.destroy(); y.destroy(); });
defineExpose({ x, y });
</script>
<template><motion.div :ref="node => element = resolveElement<HTMLElement>(node)" @mousemove="track" @mouseleave="reset"
  :style="{ x: springX, y: springY }" class="inline-block"><slot /></motion.div></template>

<script setup lang="ts">
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
import { ref } from "vue";
import { resolveElement } from "../../../lib/composables";
import Button from "./Button.vue";
import Magnetic from "./Magnetic.vue";
withDefaults(defineProps<{ strength?: number; disabled?: boolean; magneticClassName?: string }>(), { strength: 0.25 });
const button = ref<unknown>();
function focus() { resolveElement<HTMLButtonElement>(button.value)?.focus(); }
defineExpose({ focus });
</script>
<template><Magnetic :strength="strength" :class="magneticClassName"><Button ref="button" v-bind="$attrs" :disabled="disabled"><slot /></Button></Magnetic></template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, provide, ref, shallowRef, useId } from "vue";
import { motion, useSpring } from "motion-v";
import { useMotionState } from "../../state";
import { TabsContext, TABS_TRANSITION } from "./context";
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ modelValue?: string; defaultValue?: string; variant?: "pill" | "underline" | "segment"; icons?: "always" | "selected" }>(), { defaultValue: "", variant: "pill", icons: "always" });
const emit = defineEmits(["update:modelValue", "change"]);
const value = useMotionState(props, emit, "modelValue", props.defaultValue);
const id = useId();
const track = { x: useSpring(0, TABS_TRANSITION), y: useSpring(0, TABS_TRANSITION), width: useSpring(0, TABS_TRANSITION), height: useSpring(0, TABS_TRANSITION) };
const placed = ref(false);
const tabs = shallowRef(new Map<string, boolean>());
const panels = shallowRef(new Set<string>());
function registerTab(value: string, disabled: boolean) { if (tabs.value.has(value) && tabs.value.get(value) === disabled) return; tabs.value = new Map([...tabs.value, [value, disabled]]); }
function unregisterTab(value: string) { const entries = new Map(tabs.value); entries.delete(value); tabs.value = entries; }
function registerPanel(value: string) { if (!panels.value.has(value)) panels.value = new Set([...panels.value, value]); }
function unregisterPanel(value: string) { const entries = new Set(panels.value); entries.delete(value); panels.value = entries; }
const tabStop = computed(() => { if (!tabs.value.size) return null; const enabled = [...tabs.value].filter(([, disabled]) => !disabled).map(([value]) => value); return enabled.includes(value.value) ? value.value : enabled[0] ?? ""; });
function elementId(kind: string, value: string) { return `${id}-${kind}-${value.replace(/[^\w-]/g, "_")}`; }
provide(TabsContext, { value, id, variant: computed(() => props.variant), icons: computed(() => props.icons), track, placed, tabStop, tabs, panels, registerTab, unregisterTab, registerPanel, unregisterPanel, tabId: value => elementId("tab", value), panelId: value => elementId("panel", value) });
</script>
<template><motion.div layout-root><slot /></motion.div></template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, watch } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { EASE_OUT } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../../../lib/composables";
import { useTabs } from "./context";
const props = defineProps<{ value: string; forceMount?: boolean }>();
const state = useTabs();
const reduced = useReducedMotion();
const active = computed(() => state.value.value === props.value);
onMounted(() => state.registerPanel(props.value));
watch(() => props.value, (value, previous) => { state.unregisterPanel(previous); state.registerPanel(value); });
onBeforeUnmount(() => state.unregisterPanel(props.value));
</script>
<template><motion.div :id="state.panelId(value)" role="tabpanel" :aria-labelledby="state.tabId(value)" :hidden="!active" :tabindex="active ? 0 : undefined" :initial="false" :animate="active ? { opacity: 1, y: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: reduced ? 0 : 4 }" :transition="{ duration: .18, ease: EASE_OUT }" :class="active ? 'mt-4 outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/40 rounded-md' : undefined"><slot /></motion.div></template>

<script setup lang="ts">
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
import { defineComponent, provide, useId, watch, type VNodeChild } from "vue";
import {
  createTooltip,
  tooltipKey,
  type TooltipRootProps,
  type TooltipContentProps,
} from "./context";
import TooltipTrigger from "./TooltipTrigger.vue";
import TooltipContent from "./TooltipContent.vue";
export interface TooltipProps extends TooltipRootProps, TooltipContentProps {
  content?: VNodeChild;
}
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<TooltipProps>(), {
  open: undefined,
  content: undefined,
  defaultOpen: false,
});
const emit = defineEmits(["update:open", "openChange"]);
const state = createTooltip(
  props,
  emit,
  props.id ?? useId(),
  props.content === null || props.content === "",
);
provide(tooltipKey, state);
watch(
  () => props.content,
  (content) => {
    if (content !== undefined)
      state.setEmpty(content === null || content === false || content === "");
  },
  { immediate: true },
);
const ContentValue = defineComponent({
  props: ["value"],
  setup: (props) => () => props.value,
});
</script>
<template>
  <template v-if="content !== undefined"
    ><TooltipTrigger v-if="$slots.default" as-child><slot /></TooltipTrigger
    ><TooltipContent
      v-bind="$attrs"
      :side="side"
      :align="align"
      :side-offset="sideOffset"
      :arrow="arrow"
      :anchor-point="anchorPoint"
      ><ContentValue :value="content" /></TooltipContent></template
  ><slot v-else />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, provide } from "vue";
import { timingKey } from "./context";
const props = defineProps<{
  delay?: number;
  closeDelay?: number;
  skipDelay?: number;
  skipDelayDuration?: number;
}>();
const inherited = inject(
  timingKey,
  computed(() => ({ delay: 120, closeDelay: 0, skipDelay: 300 })),
);
provide(
  timingKey,
  computed(() => ({
    delay: props.delay ?? inherited.value.delay,
    closeDelay: props.closeDelay ?? inherited.value.closeDelay,
    skipDelay:
      props.skipDelay ?? props.skipDelayDuration ?? inherited.value.skipDelay,
  })),
);
</script>
<template><slot /></template>

<script lang="ts">
import {
  Comment,
  Fragment,
  Text,
  cloneVNode,
  defineComponent,
  h,
  type VNode,
} from "vue";
import { useTooltip } from "./context";
function flatten(nodes: VNode[]): VNode[] {
  return nodes.flatMap((node) =>
    node.type === Fragment
      ? flatten(node.children as VNode[])
      : node.type === Comment ||
          (node.type === Text && !String(node.children).trim())
        ? []
        : [node],
  );
}
export default defineComponent({
  name: "TooltipTrigger",
  inheritAttrs: false,
  props: { asChild: Boolean },
  setup(props, { attrs, slots }) {
    const state = useTooltip();
    return () => {
      const describedBy =
        [
          attrs["aria-describedby"],
          state.open.value && !state.empty.value ? state.id : undefined,
        ]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(" ") || undefined;
      const a11y = state.props.asLabel
        ? {
            "aria-labelledby": state.empty.value
              ? attrs["aria-labelledby"]
              : state.labelId,
          }
        : { "aria-describedby": describedBy };
      const properties = {
        ...attrs,
        ...a11y,
        "data-state": state.open.value ? "open" : "closed",
        ref: state.setTrigger,
      };
      const children = slots.default?.() ?? [];
      if (!props.asChild)
        return h("button", { type: "button", ...properties }, children);
      const elements = flatten(children);
      return elements.length === 1
        ? cloneVNode(elements[0]!, properties, true)
        : elements.length
          ? elements
          : null;
    };
  },
});
</script>
